def VTask.ofLeftInverse {α : Sort u_3} {β : Type u_4} (f : α → β) (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) (hf : ∀ (h : Nonempty α), Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) : α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) where
  toFun := fun a => ⟨f a, Set.mem_range_self a⟩
  invFun := fun x => f_inv (Exists.imp (fun _ _ => True) x.2) x.1
  left_inv := fun a => (hf (Exists.imp (fun _ _ => True) (Set.mem_range_self a))) a
  right_inv := fun x => Subtype.eq (
    let y := x.1
    let h_y := x.2
    let h_nonempty := Exists.imp (fun _ _ => True) h_y
    let g := f_inv h_nonempty
    match h_y with
    | ⟨a, eq⟩ => Eq.subst (fun (y' : β) => f (g y') = y') eq (congr_arg f (hf h_nonempty a))
  )
